title: Patch Me Out
description: Small tweaks, free shop, no banlist, and a crash log.

settings.title: Auto pause
settings.help: Pause the game when its window loses focus.

settings.title: Use JP
settings.help: Use the Japanese rules and card data where the game has them.

settings.title: No janken
settings.help: Skip rock-paper-scissors at the start of a duel (offline duels; online duels still play it).

settings.title: Who goes first
settings.help: Who goes first when NoJanken skips rock-paper-scissors: P1 = you, P2 = your opponent, random = either.

settings.title: Starting LP
settings.help: Life points each duelist starts a duel with.
